title: Debt Payoff Planner
h1: Four debts, one extra $200 a month. Which one gets it?
sub: Rank your debts by avalanche or snowball, flag anything above about 7% APR, and see exactly where the extra money goes.
heroMicro: Google Sheet (.xlsx) + printable PDF. Opens in Google Sheets or Excel. Instant download.
preview_labels: Progress page: color in as the total falls

uvp.p: Avalanche (highest rate first) and snowball (smallest balance first) side by side.
Anything above about 7% APR is marked as a priority.
One debt gets the extra payment each month, and the sheet tells you which.

stat.t: Searches for a Google Sheets debt payoff template rose 1,050% in the US, Jan-Sep 2026 against 2025. This one is built to do the ranking for you.

benefits.p: Balance, APR and minimum payment for each debt, in one place.
Avalanche or snowball. Pick the one you will actually stick with.
A monthly progress tab shows the total going down.
A printable version is included for the fridge or the desk.

List each debt with its balance, APR and minimum. For a handful of debts that is a short sitting.

faq.q: Does it connect to my bank?
faq.a: No. You type the numbers in. Nothing is linked to your accounts.

faq.q: Can I print it or use it on a tablet?
faq.a: Yes. The printable PDF works on paper or in any PDF app. It is US Letter and prints on A4 at fit to page.
